scope: Archived final cohort only; no simulation, training, inference or experiment imports
quantiles: Linear interpolation at (n-1)*p, matching numpy.quantile default; pooled raw rows, not averages of repeat quantiles

environment.cpu_model_note: No CPU model recorded in the inspected run preflight resource artifacts.
environment.exclusivity_note: Hardware visibility does not prove provider-level GPU exclusivity or storage quota.

timing_boundary.primary_metric: e2e_ms is perf_counter_ns wall elapsed, not GPU-only time
timing_boundary.timer_start: after initial torch.cuda.synchronize(), before make_observation()/view and candidate generation
included: PINO predictions and CPU feature transfer
method scoring including FV CPU branch or residual policy
score CPU transfer, choice, probabilities, CPU command list and validation
excluded: sensor acquisition wait, physical actuation and communication
timing_boundary.gpu_event_caveat: gpu_compute_ms/CUDA-event elapsed brackets mixed GPU work and host-controlled gaps, including the CPU FV branch; it is not pure kernel execution time or a separable GPU component.
timing_boundary.fallback_paths: Missing observations bypass observer/PINO/scorer; no-feasible paths run observer/PINO/gate and bypass method scoring.
timing_boundary.baseline_caveat: PI and FV-MPC also incur the shared observer/PINO feasibility-filter overhead; timings describe these implemented pipelines.
timing_boundary.simulation_trace_caveat: Only delay_ms selected by trace_request drives simulated arrivals; the e2e_ms measured during the replay computation is not substituted for the archived delay.
timing_boundary.replay_rule: Interleave repeat 0/1/2 rows, filter exact fallback reason and nearest tokens, select request-index modulo matching pool, restart request index in every episode.

interpretation: FV degradation co-occurs with an identical repeated miss/zero-fallback/busy-skip schedule. No archived no-miss counterfactual isolates misses from other application delays; the 24 repeats are not independent latency sequences.
